[G]Floating down
[Gaug]through the clouds
[Em/G]Memories come rushing

[G]space between the heavens and the

[Gaug]Goodbye Ma.
[Em/G]After the service when you're
[C]walking slowly to the car And the
[G]silver in her hair shines in the cold
[D]November air
[Em]You hear the tolling bell And
[Cmaj7]touch the silk in your lapel And
[G]as the tear drops rise to meet the
[D]comfort of the band
[Em]
[C]You take her frail
[D]hand
And hold on to the dream.

[Em]noone ever disappears You never hear their standard issue
